fields.description: The shape of the condition. Aggregate percentage is deliberately NOT here - that is Total Seats' neighbour Minimum Percentage on the intake itself, which already exists and is now enforced. One question, one mechanism

fields.label: Subject
fields.description: Required by the two Subject rules, ignored by the others

fields.label: Threshold
fields.description: The number the rule compares against: a percentage, a rank or a score depending on the rule. Ignored by Subject Required, which asks only that the subject was taken

fields.label: Remarks
fields.description: The regulation or university norm this condition comes from
